goal: Community + moderation over promoted vehicle context: comments/replies/votes/reports/moderation queue/research-lead labeling — scope-safe, abuse-resistant, anecdotal, auditable. No catalog/provenance contamination.
blueprint_sections: 24 AI classification (metadata only, no auto-ban, no spec facts)

current_behavior.identity: lib/community/identity.ts — anonymous: ipHash (sha256 salted) + tci_token cookie; votes key on hashIp, reports key on cookie||hashIp
current_behavior.rate_limit: lib/security/rate-limit.ts in-memory sliding window + _resetRateLimitStore() for tests
current_behavior.ui: CommunitySection (304 lines) on vehicle detail: label 'ความคิดเห็นจากชุมชน' + disclaimer 'ความคิดเห็นเป็นของผู้ใช้งาน ไม่ใช่ข้อมูลที่ได้รับการตรวจสอบจากแหล่งทางการ'; vote/reply/report controls; admin moderation page (181 lines) with token + HIDE/DELETE/RESTORE + research-lead form
current_behavior.schema_constraints: CommunityComment.modelId/variantId are bare Uuid columns with NO relation/FK; CommentVote @@unique(commentId,voterToken); CommentReport @@unique(commentId,reporterToken); CommentStatus VISIBLE/HIDDEN/FLAGGED/DELETED; NO edit endpoint exists (edit-history N/A), NO community user table (anonymous by design)

reproduced_gaps.gap: POST /api/community/comments persists `isResearchLead: Boolean(isResearchLead)` from the CLIENT — any caller self-grants the research-lead badge; the trusted setter is only /api/admin/community/research-lead
reply scope: `modelId: modelId ?? parent.modelId` — client payload OVERRIDES the parent scope; payload can also inject a mismatched modelId/variantId pair into a reply

modelId/variantId never validated: malformed UUID → Prisma validation throw (no client-safe response); nonexistent/inactive entity → orphan row persisted with 201; modelId+variantId both supplied but belonging to different models → misattribution accepted; GET has the same format hole and page/limit parseInt can yield NaN

report identity = `cookie || hashIp`: clearing the tci_token cookie mints a new reporterToken, so ONE actor can reach the 3-report auto-hide threshold on any comment (unique key is per-token, not per-IP)
blocked-words check (Blueprint 23 minimum) does not exist anywhere in the community POST path
GET/vote/report/admin routes have no try/catch: an internal DB error propagates as a thrown exception instead of a client-safe JSON error (and malformed ids surface through Prisma validation errors)
GET ordering is [upvotes desc, createdAt desc] with no final tiebreak — equal-score comments can order differently between identical runs

green_guards_regressions: F: public GET where(status VISIBLE, deletedAt null) on parents AND replies — must keep excluding FLAGGED/HIDDEN/DELETED
H: vote contract commentId_voterToken + transaction idempotency/switch + counters == vote-row invariant
K: moderation queue lists unresolved reports; PATCH HIDE reflected on subsequent public GET; wrong bearer → 401
L: no catalog/provenance file references community tables; anecdotal label + disclaimer stay in CommunitySection; evidence flags come only from spec sourceTier
A/B: model-scope and variant-scope persistence with exact column attribution

acceptance_tests.A: P117-A POST model comment → GET model scope returns it with correct modelId
acceptance_tests.B: P117-B POST variant comment → GET variant scope returns it; model scope of another model does not
acceptance_tests.C: P117-C malicious reply payload with foreign modelId/variantId still inherits parent scope exactly
acceptance_tests.D: P117-D mismatch model+variant → 400; nonexistent → 404; inactive → 404; malformed UUID → 400 (POST and GET)
acceptance_tests.E: P117-E isResearchLead:true in client POST → persisted false; only admin research-lead route sets true
acceptance_tests.F: P117-F hidden/deleted/rejected parents+replies absent from GET list, replies and total
acceptance_tests.G: P117-G report durable + idempotent per IP + 3 distinct reporters → FLAGGED with report rows preserved (evidence kept)
acceptance_tests.H: P117-H duplicate/conflicting votes deterministic per identity; upvotes/downvotes == vote rows
acceptance_tests.I: P117-I malformed UUID/enum/oversized body/page=abc → 400 safe JSON; forced DB error → 500 JSON with no stack/SQL/Prisma text
acceptance_tests.J: P117-J blocked word → 400, NO row persisted (false positive cannot become an official fact); deterministic on fixture
acceptance_tests.K: P117-K queue shows flagged fixture; PATCH HIDE → public GET excludes; RESTORE → returns
acceptance_tests.L: P117-L catalog/evidence sources contain no CommunityComment/CommentVote/CommentReport reference; label+disclaimer text present
acceptance_tests.M: P117-M repeated GET identical order/ids; orderBy captured with id tiebreak
acceptance_tests.N: P117 smoke: vehicle detail community controls render (heading, disclaimer, form, vote/report), mobile 390px, console errors 0, touch targets

new_files: lib/community/blocked-words.ts (starter spam/abuse word list + normalized matcher)
lib/community/scope.ts (UUID + entity existence/ACTIVE + model/variant consistency validation shared by routes)
fixes: D1 strip isResearchLead from client payload (always false); admin research-lead route remains the sole setter
D2 replies inherit parent scope verbatim — client modelId/variantId ignored for replies

D3 shared scope validator: isValidUuid → 400; CarModel/Variant existence + ACTIVE → 404; both-ids consistency (variant.modelId === modelId) → 400; GET same format validation + finite page/limit; fail closed
D4 reporterToken = hashIp(ip) always (same identity family as votes; one report per comment per IP); NAT tradeoff disclosed
D5 blocked-words matcher (NFKC-safe lowercase, Thai+EN starter list) → 400 before persist
D6 try/catch on all community routes → generic JSON 400/500, message never includes SQL/stack/Prisma internals
D7 orderBy final tiebreak id asc

data_boundary.community_writes: tests may create fixtures ONLY in CommunityComment/CommentVote/CommentReport with a '[p117-fixture]' marker or unique ids, cleaned up in afterAll; no writes to catalog/price/spec tables
data_boundary.rate_limits: tests use unique x-forwarded-for IPs per case and _resetRateLimitStore()
data_boundary.admin_auth: tests set process.env.ADMIN_API_TOKEN before exercising admin routes

non_goals: no Prisma schema/migration (schema supports every mandatory boundary; edit history is N/A because no edit endpoint exists — disclosed)
no new community architecture, no user accounts
no AI auto-ban (Blueprint 24: classification stays additive metadata; no provider changes)
no redesign of CommunitySection beyond what boundaries require
honest_limits_planned: in-memory rate limiter is single-process only (documented in helper)
report/vote identity is per-IP (NAT users share one identity) — chosen over per-cookie because cookie rotation enabled auto-hide spam
blocked-words list is a disclosed starter list, not an exhaustive profanity filter
edit history not implemented: no edit endpoint exists in the repo
